name: B10-0356/2025 (Renew) – Strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to help Moldova defend itself against Russian interference before Moldova's parliamentary elections on 28 September 2025. It asks for more money and resources for security and defence support, stronger sanctions against people and groups undermining Moldova, help against fake news and cyberattacks, and continued support for Moldova's path to joining the EU. The text is the Parliament's position and set of requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament asks the EU to give Moldova more support and sanctions.
- **Who it affects:** Moldova's government and voters, the EU, and sanctioned Russian-linked figures.
- **What happens next:** The EU institutions and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
